Full diallel among six maize lines

Source: R/breeding.R
maize_diallel.Rd

Simulated yields of a complete diallel (Griffing's method 1: parents, F1 and reciprocals) among six inbred lines, in three randomised complete blocks. The other methods use subsets of the same data.

Usage

maize_diallel

Format

A data frame with 108 rows and 4 columns:

Block

Block (1-3).

Female

Female parent (P1-P6).

Male

Male parent (P1-P6); equal to Female for the parents.

Yield_t_ha

Grain yield, t/ha.

Examples

diallel(maize_diallel, "Yield_t_ha", "Female", "Male", block = "Block", method = 2)
